justification: Frontend + API change: adds data_status field to structured controls API, three-state visual rendering in component. Fixes value_min=0 falsy bug. No DB schema changes.

pre_impl.existing_data: API previously returned no needs_review info. Frontend showed grey dash for all NULL values regardless of reason.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: value_min=0 was treated as null (falsy check). Fixed to != null check.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Adds data_status field to API response. Backward compatible — component falls back to hasNumericValue check if data_status missing.

functions.name: GET
functions.if_none: If needs_review column missing from DB, row.needs_review is undefined, treated as false — falls back to not_applicable

functions.name: DcpStructuredControls
functions.input: formerCouncil slug string + optional devType string prop from parent component
functions.output: Renders three visual states: numeric (bold value), not_applicable (no rate + italic condition), under_review (amber pending badge)
functions.if_none: If data_status missing from API (backward compat), falls back to numeric vs not_applicable based on value_min/max nullity

values.guard_at: DcpStructuredControls.tsx:188-189 — fallback via ?? operator if data_status undefined
values.if_missing: Falls back to hasNumericValue check — same behavior as before this change

values.nullable: yes — null when DCP has no numeric rate
values.guard_at: route.ts:190 — uses != null instead of falsy check (fixes value=0 bug)
values.if_missing: Renders as 'no rate' or 'pending' depending on data_status

queries.purpose: Fetch structured controls with needs_review flag
queries.where_clause: sc.lga IN ($1...) AND sc.dev_type = $N AND (sc.is_current IS NULL OR sc.is_current = true)
queries.if_zero: Returns has_controls: false with empty categories
queries.if_wrong: needs_review=true rows correctly tagged as under_review in response

break_it.scenario: needs_review column doesn't exist on older DB schema
break_it.what_happens: SQL query would fail with column not found error
break_it.how: needs_review column exists since table creation (confirmed in DB_SCHEMA.md). If somehow missing, query error is caught at route.ts:232 and returns 500.

break_it.scenario: needs_review=true row with non-null value_min classified as under_review instead of numeric
break_it.what_happens: User sees 'pending' badge instead of the actual value
break_it.how: route.ts:195 — hasNumeric check comes first. If value_min or value_max is non-null, data_status is always 'numeric' regardless of needs_review.

break_it.scenario: data_status field missing from API response (cache/CDN serving old version)
DB query for structured controls fails (timeout, connection error)
break_it.what_happens: API returns 500, component shows nothing (SWR error state)
break_it.how: route.ts:231-233 — catch block logs error and returns 500 JSON. Component's useSWR handles error state — returns null (no broken UI).

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes — load /assessment for a council with NULL controls (e.g. ashfield). Verify: numeric rows show bold value, not_applicable rows show 'no rate' + italic condition, any needs_review rows show amber 'pending' badge.
